text:
jordan: Quick sync after design review 3: docs panel vs modal for in-product help. Need decision so eng can implement before sprint end.

priya: Docs POV: favor right-side panel for two reasons: 1) we can serve canonical content and update without changing UI; 2) panel supports deep anchors and example sandboxes.

leah: Design: panel keeps context (user stays on the page) and supports persistent state (expand/collapse). Modals are useful for step-by-step tasks, but they interrupt keyboard flow.

sam: DevEx: we should avoid duplicating copy between UI and docs. If panel pulls content from docs (API-backed), we need a stable doc-id URI (e.g. help://serving/reserved-capacity) and a cache policy.

priya: Agree on doc-id scheme. We can expose a small JSON endpoint /help/embeds/{doc-id} that returns HTML snippet + anchors + metadata (last_updated, locales, canonical_url).

leah: UX nit: panel header should show badge "Docs (excerpt)" and an "Open full doc" affordance that opens docs in a new tab. Also add a tiny search box in-panel that queries docs anchors.

sam: Accessibility: if panel is opened, focus should move into the panel and be trap-free (escape closes panel and returns focus to trigger). Provide aria-live for content changes and ensure panel is reachable via keyboard only.

priya: Localization: we need docs snippets returned in user's locale when available. Fallback order: app locale -> Accept-Language header -> en-US. Add locale metadata on the embed endpoint.

jordan: What about analytics? We talked about help.open and help.opened previously. Need to capture where help came from (source UI), the doc-id, and user flow (e.g., "deploy-flow > model-selection").

sam: Proposed event schema: help.opened {source: panel|modal|tooltip, doc_id: string, route: string, help_variant: short|full, locale: string}. Will add to Telemetry schema.

infra-bot: feature: help-panel-proxy deployed to staging at 2025-03-18T09:04Z

priya: Copy consistency: docs currently use "variant" in model pages but UI shows "version" in a few places. Suggest a docs-first approach: change UI to "variant" and add a migration tooltip for 2 weeks for existing users.

leah: Also propose microcopy revisions for the deploy flow: instead of "Dedicated" use "Reserved capacity (Dedicated)" for a roll-out period, so contracts/search still match.

jordan: Good compromise. Acceptance criteria: 1) Panel uses docs embed (no local copy), 2) panel header links to canonical docs, 3) help.opened telemetry emitted, 4) UI terminology consistent with docs and migration tooltip in prod for 14 days.

sam: I will draft PRs: platform proxy for /help/embeds, client-side panel component, and telemetry. Tickets: PLAT-540 (proxy), UI-341 (panel), TELE-77 (events).

priya: I'll add embed endpoints and create redirects for old slugs. ETA: 3 business days.

leah: I'll add mocks (desktop + narrow width) and keyboard interaction flows to the design folder.

jordan: Let's use a feature flag help:panel.v1 to roll out to a subset of orgs first. Please include telemetry to count opens per org and feedback button clicks.

infra-bot: featureflag: help.panel.v1 enabled for beta orgs at 2025-03-19T14:00Z

jordan: OK closing thread. We'll reconvene after staging verification. Quick summary: panel backed by docs embed wins for canonical copy and anchors; modals reserved for task flows; implement doc-id embed endpoint + telemetry + i18n support.

jordan: TL;DR: docs-as-source, panel for reference, modals for tutorials. Action owners listed above.
